Initially it was just white and black. Other colors were added to the martial arts belts when they started teaching in foreign countries (with more students it became more useful to distinguish their level of instruction, and the westerners didn't tend to have the kind of patience the Japanese were accustomed to). I've heard various explanations for the colors in terms of symbolism, but the progression seems to have been mainly based on the fact that the students would start with a white belt and dye it as they were promoted; thus it would get darker with each promotion. The original colors where: white -> green -> brown -> black.

The dan/que system originated from China, and was specifically created for the game: Go. It was eventually adopted into other games and sports.
